components.name: Home Primary Action
components.description: Home action with native focus semantics.
components.html: <button class="ds-home-primary" type="button"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path fill="currentColor" d="M7 28a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V5a1 1 0 0 1 1.482-.876l20 11a1 1 0 0 1 0 1.752l-20 11A1 1 0 0 1 7 28"/></svg>Run all tests</button>
components.css: .ds-home-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--histoire-accent-link, rgb(4 120 87)); color: var(--histoire-surface, rgb(255 255 255)); font: 700 13px var(--histoire-font-sans, "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-home-primary:hover { background: var(--histoire-accent-link, rgb(4 120 87)); } .ds-home-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--histoire-accent, rgb(5 150 105)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Home Secondary Action
components.description: Home action with native focus semantics.
components.html: <button class="ds-home-secondary" type="button"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path fill="currentColor" d="m25.7 9.3l-7-7c-.2-.2-.4-.3-.7-.3H8c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v24c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h16c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V10c0-.3-.1-.5-.3-.7M18 4.4l5.6 5.6H18zM24 28H8V4h8v6c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h6z"/><path fill="currentColor" d="M10 22h12v2H10zm0-6h12v2H10z"/></svg>Get started</button>
components.css: .ds-home-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--histoire-border, rgb(228 228 231)); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--histoire-surface, rgb(255 255 255)); color: var(--histoire-text, rgb(24 24 27)); font: 700 13px var(--histoire-font-sans, "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-home-secondary:hover { background: var(--histoire-surface, rgb(255 255 255)); } .ds-home-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--histoire-accent, rgb(5 150 105)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Rail Destination
components.description: Square Carbon destination with active green tint.
components.html: <nav aria-label="Workbench"><button class="ds-rail-button" type="button" aria-label="Stories" title="Stories" aria-pressed="true"><svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path fill="currentColor" d="M26 2H8a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v4H4v2h2v5H4v2h2v5H4v2h2v4a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h18a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V4a2 2 0 0 0-2-2m0 26H8v-4h2v-2H8v-5h2v-2H8v-5h2V8H8V4h18Z"/><path fill="currentColor" d="M14 8h8v2h-8zm0 7h8v2h-8zm0 7h8v2h-8z"/></svg></button></nav>
components.css: .ds-rail-button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--histoire-muted, rgb(95 99 112)); cursor: pointer; } .ds-rail-button:hover { color: var(--histoire-text, rgb(24 24 27)); background: var(--histoire-chip, rgb(244 244 245)); } .ds-rail-button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--histoire-accent, rgb(5 150 105)); background: var(--histoire-accent-soft, rgb(236 253 245)); } .ds-rail-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--histoire-accent, rgb(5 150 105)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rail-button:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Toolbar Tool
components.description: Compact neutral icon button used inside canvas toolbar.
components.html: <button class="ds-toolbar-button" type="button" aria-label="Measure" title="Measure" aria-pressed="false"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path fill="currentColor" d="M29 10H3a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h26a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V11a1 1 0 0 0-1-1m-1 10H4v-8h4v4h2v-4h5v4h2v-4h5v4h2v-4h4Z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-toolbar-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; min-width: 28px; height: 28px; padding: 0 5px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--histoire-muted, rgb(95 99 112)); font: 13px var(--histoire-font-sans, "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-toolbar-button:hover,.ds-toolbar-button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--histoire-text, rgb(24 24 27)); background: var(--histoire-chip, rgb(244 244 245)); } .ds-toolbar-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--histoire-accent, rgb(5 150 105)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-toolbar-button:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Inset pane search with Carbon icon and mono shortcut.
components.html: <label class="ds-search-field"><svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path fill="currentColor" d="m29 27.586l-7.552-7.552a11.018 11.018 0 1 0-1.414 1.414L27.586 29ZM4 13a9 9 0 1 1 9 9a9.01 9.01 0 0 1-9-9"/></svg><input type="search" aria-label="Search" placeholder="Search"><kbd>Ctrl K</kbd></label>
components.css: .ds-search-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--histoire-border, rgb(228 228 231)); border-radius: var(--histoire-radius-control,7px); background: var(--histoire-chip, rgb(244 244 245)); color: var(--histoire-text, rgb(24 24 27)); font: 13px var(--histoire-font-sans, "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-search-field:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--histoire-accent, rgb(5 150 105)); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-search-field input { min-width: 0; width: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: none; background: transparent; font: inherit; color: inherit; } .ds-search-field input::placeholder { color: var(--histoire-muted, rgb(95 99 112)); } .ds-search-field svg { flex: none; color: var(--histoire-muted, rgb(95 99 112)); } .ds-search-field kbd { color: var(--histoire-muted, rgb(95 99 112)); font: 11px var(--histoire-font-mono, "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Selected Story Row
components.description: Readable selected variant row with roving tree semantics.
components.css: .ds-story-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; width: 100%; min-height: 31px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--histoire-text, rgb(24 24 27)); font: 13px var(--histoire-font-sans, "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif); text-align: start; cursor: pointer; } .ds-story-row:hover { background: var(--histoire-chip, rgb(244 244 245)); } .ds-story-row[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--histoire-accent-soft, rgb(236 253 245)); color: var(--histoire-accent-text, rgb(6 95 70)); font-weight: 700; } .ds-story-row svg { flex: none; color: var(--histoire-accent, rgb(5 150 105)); } .ds-tree-chevron { width: 11px; flex: none; } .ds-story-label { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-story-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--histoire-accent, rgb(5 150 105)); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Inspector Tabs
components.description: Text-only tabs on neutral track with selected surface lift.
components.css: .ds-inspector-tabs { gap: 1px; display: flex; padding: 3px; margin: 0 12px 14px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--histoire-chip, rgb(244 244 245)); } .ds-inspector-tabs button { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--histoire-muted, rgb(95 99 112)); cursor: pointer; font: 700 13px var(--histoire-font-sans, "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-inspector-tabs button:hover { color: var(--histoire-text, rgb(24 24 27)); } .ds-inspector-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--histoire-text, rgb(24 24 27)); background: var(--histoire-surface, rgb(255 255 255)); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / .08); } .ds-inspector-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--histoire-accent, rgb(5 150 105)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Inspector Prop Input
components.description: Body-size field with mono prop name and type.
components.css: .ds-prop-field { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; margin: 0 0 18px; color: var(--histoire-text, rgb(24 24 27)); } .ds-prop-label { padding-right: 70px; font: 13px var(--histoire-font-mono, "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); } .ds-prop-type { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; max-width: 70px; color: var(--histoire-muted, rgb(95 99 112)); font: 13px var(--histoire-font-mono, "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); } .ds-prop-field input { min-height: 34px; padding: 7px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--histoire-border, rgb(228 228 231)); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--histoire-input, rgb(250 250 250)); color: var(--histoire-text, rgb(24 24 27)); font: 13px var(--histoire-font-sans, "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-prop-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--histoire-accent, rgb(5 150 105)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Browse Card
components.description: Flat catalog card with tinted Carbon icon tile.
components.css: .ds-browse-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--histoire-border, rgb(228 228 231)); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--histoire-surface, rgb(255 255 255)); color: var(--histoire-text, rgb(24 24 27)); font: 13px var(--histoire-font-sans, "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-browse-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; } .ds-browse-titles { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-browse-titles strong { display: block; font-size: 13px; } .ds-browse-titles > span { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--histoire-muted, rgb(95 99 112)); font-size: 11px; } .ds-browse-icon { display: grid; flex: 0 0 36px; place-items: center; height: 36px; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--histoire-accent-soft, rgb(236 253 245)); color: var(--histoire-accent, rgb(5 150 105)); } .ds-browse-card:hover { border-color: var(--histoire-accent, rgb(5 150 105)); } .ds-browse-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--histoire-accent, rgb(5 150 105)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: MCP Status Chip
components.description: Status word and dot use semantic green only when enabled.
components.css: .ds-mcp-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--histoire-muted, rgb(95 99 112)); background: var(--histoire-chip, rgb(244 244 245)); font: 700 11px var(--histoire-font-sans, "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-mcp-status[data-status="enabled"] { color: var(--histoire-accent-link, rgb(4 120 87)); background: var(--histoire-accent-soft, rgb(236 253 245)); } .ds-mcp-status > span { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: currentColor; border-radius: 50%; }

narrative.overview:
C1 organizes component work as a quiet spatial workbench: a slim rail, one swappable pane, an open canvas, and a floating inspector. Flat neutral grounds keep component previews central. Sparse green marks selection, live state, focus, and successful tests.

Manrope carries interface labels and titles; JetBrains Mono distinguishes source, prop names, dimensions, counts, and shortcuts. Light and dark share hierarchy and geometry. Compact controls support repeated inspection without adding explanatory copy.
keyCharacteristics: Flat neutral grounds with sparse semantic color.
Compact interface type and explicit technical metadata.
Rounded floating tools around independent preview content.
Equivalent light and dark structure with reachable narrow-layout controls.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Use green for actionable or selected workbench state. Keep violet specific to event counts and agent/comment activity, red specific to failure or measurement, and neutral surfaces dominant.

rules.name: The Preview Boundary Rule
rules.body: Scope workbench tokens and fonts to the owning provider. Component previews keep their own visual system.

rules.name: The Readable Controls Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary inspector fields, prop names, types, and tabs at the body or label size. Smaller metadata styles belong to counts, breadcrumbs, shortcuts, and source.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: Keep page grounds, rail, and side panes flat. Use soft shadows for floating chrome and small selected-control or toggle cues.

dos: Do use semantic workbench variables so theme changes reach native SDK surfaces.
Do use bundled Carbon SVGs and text labels for inspector tabs.
Do preserve provider-relative rail, pane, toolbar, and inspector bounds.
Do keep every narrow-layout rail action and canvas tool reachable.
Do use real catalog labels and counts; unnamed Home groups receive Stories or Guides labels.
donts: Don't apply workbench fonts or palette to story preview documents.
Don't use green or violet as decoration unrelated to state or action.
Don't add explanatory filler or replace real project content with board sample data.
Don't turn local legacy styling differences into new global tokens.
